definitions.frames_received: successful screenshot polls; each poll is the kernel's latest BMP
definitions.unique_frames: distinct SHA256 of those BMPs; a repeated image counts once
definitions.gap_ms: inter-arrival of successful polls, t_i - t_{i-1}, milliseconds
definitions.sequence_frames: kernel status frames delta; increments on every pipe write, including identical pixels

limits: Kernel frame store keeps the latest BMP only, so it cannot accumulate a display backlog. This samples the kernel, not the console present path. A still screen correctly yields a low uniqueness ratio.
